tracks.name: rocq
tracks.description: Prove in Rocq that submitted RISC-V bytes satisfy the fixed init-e Certificate for the Pancake EVM guest within a step bound K, checked by recursive kernel replay, and minimize K. The initial submission claims infinity.
tracks.hardware: Official runs: blacksmith-32vcpu-ubuntu-2404 (128 GB RAM), on the runner with Bubblewrap user, PID and network namespaces. Each verifier stage is limited to 21,600 s and 112 GiB of address space. Upstream: the trusted build peaked at 30.3 GiB RSS, and the baseline kernel stage took over 3 hours but under 6. Cold setup builds OCaml, Rocq and the trusted library with dune -j 1; its total time is not yet measured (23-hour job timeout).
